role: XCUITest of fresh-install (nothing granted) states: Dashboard first-reading prompt, and Get Me Back responding (disclaimer, location guidance, screen, or system prompt) without a location grant.

flags.text: Passes the bare '-UITests' launch argument, which no production code reads (only -UITests-FreshInstall at AppLaunchRecovery.swift:185 and -UITests-ForcePaywall/-UITests-SeedArchive at UITestLaunchArguments.swift:18,23 are checked); it is inert

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Swipes the app up to `attempts` times until the element exists and isHittable; returns the final exists&&isHittable.

flags.text: Calls bare isHittable, which the harness documents raises when no activation point can be derived (EmuquUITests.swift:247-259) instead of returning false

units.does: Asserts Dashboard tab selection succeeds and a 'Take your first reading' text appears.

units.does: Selects Fitness, scrolls until the 'Get Me Back' tile is hittable and taps it, then asserts any of: 'I understand' button, 'Get Me Back needs location' text, 'Get Me Back' nav bar, or a SpringBoard alert.

flags.text: Requires the Get Me Back tile, which lives in WorkoutPreflightView and renders only once the recorder exists; FitnessTabUITests treats that absence as legitimate on a simulator (best-effort check, XCTSkipUnless), so the two suites disagree on whether this is a failure
